The historical CFI term maps directly to considered_for_inclusion.; Source: ethereum/EIPs commit 1708a6cb84d6 (Update EIP-7773: update EIP status for glamsterdam); Source URL: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/1708a6cb84d683e9baa7ff9b5afc118e51b8415b; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/1708a6cb84d683e9baa7ff9b5afc118e51b8415b

date: Jul 13, 2026; event_kind: unknown; Normalized state: Uncertain transition; Recorded at: 2026-07-13T07:12:57Z; Historical label: listed under 'EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion' after removal of the 'Considered for Inclusion' heading; Normalization rationale: Commit e338bc94 (PR #11853) removed the 'Considered for Inclusion' heading, leaving the whole CFI list rendered under the 'EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion' heading. The PR body describes its intent as a stage restructuring that adds EIP-8282 and EIP-7610 to Considered for Inclusion, and the same-day correction PR #11917 states the changes 'were not completely correct'. Three days later the ACDE #241 call (2026-07-16) recorded that Glamsterdam EIPs were 'not yet moved to SFI' (ACDbot summary, 00:25:12), confirming no scheduling decision existed on 2026-07-13, so the apparent SFI placement is treated as an editorial error and normalized to unknown rather than scheduled_for_inclusion.; Source: ethereum/EIPs commit e338bc94c99e (Update EIP-7773: Update upgrade stages); Source URL: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/e338bc94c99e69ef86eed3cf6c5f7825073a61b1; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/e338bc94c99e69ef86eed3cf6c5f7825073a61b1

date: Jul 13, 2026; event_kind: unknown; Normalized state: Uncertain transition; Recorded at: 2026-07-13T11:41:54Z; Historical label: restored to re-added 'Considered for Inclusion' section; Normalization rationale: Correction commit (PR #11917) restoring the 'Considered for Inclusion' section and this EIP's placement in it, hours after PR #11853's erroneous restructuring. It re-establishes the previously decided CFI status rather than recording a new inclusion decision (and is not a removal from schedule), so it is normalized to unknown; the restored state is 'Considered for Inclusion'.; Source: ethereum/EIPs commit 7a8f203e5e8b (Update EIP-7773: re-add CFI/restore EIP-8136/EIP-8189 status); Source URL: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/7a8f203e5e8be01dfa6c928765eec709cb42e6fe; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/7a8f203e5e8be01dfa6c928765eec709cb42e6fe

date: Aug 05, 2026; event_kind: scheduled_for_inclusion; Normalized state: SFI; Recorded at: 2026-08-05T02:55:08Z; Historical label: moved from 'Considered for Inclusion' to 'EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion' (SFI); Normalization rationale: The Meta EIP change moves the EIP from 'Considered for Inclusion' to 'EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion' and removes the CFI section. PR #12022 attributes the promotion of all remaining Core CFI EIPs to the ACDC #183 (2026-07-23) decisions; the ACDC #183 minutes record 'All devnet-7 EIPs ratified SFI; PRs to update EIP statuses will be opened' with testing (EthPandaOps) and EL teams confirming readiness (ACDbot summary, 00:21:33). The SFI question had been raised at ACDE #241 (2026-07-16). The historical SFI term maps directly to scheduled_for_inclusion. path.aria-label: date: Feb 12, 2025; value: 0; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-02-12T21:16:12+08:00; Change type: editorial; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: Three typo fixes: the BeaconState field name 'latest_widthdrawals_root' is corrected to 'latest_withdrawals_root' in both places it appears, 'the latests withdrawals' becomes 'the latest withdrawals', and the anchor text '[Secutiry Considerations]' becomes '[Security Considerations]'.; Classification rationale: Spelling corrections only. The misspelled field name was already used in its correct spelling elsewhere in the same paragraph ('withdrawals matching the state.latest_withdrawals_root'), so the fix removes an internal inconsistency in a summary of the consensus-specs field name rather than changing any data structure.; Confidence: high; Commit: 2a6b6965e64787815f7fffb9a4c27660d9683846; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/2a6b6965e64787815f7fffb9a4c27660d9683846; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/2a6b6965e64787815f7fffb9a4c27660d9683846

date: Aug 12, 2025; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-08-12T17:16:28+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Resynchronises the EIP with the consensus-specs design, repinning the six links to consensus-specs 9e2dc0bcf9aa17b549e1df4712b16a5709d74119 and rewriting the summary. The builder payment becomes an execution-layer withdrawal to a proposer-chosen address rather than a direct beacon-balance credit; PTC attestations also cover blob data availability. PAYLOAD_ABSENT/PRESENT/WITHHELD/INVALID_STATUS are dropped and PayloadAttestationData's uint8 payload_status becomes the booleans payload_present and blob_data_available; new BuilderPendingPayment and BuilderPendingWithdrawal containers, the BUILDER_PEDING_WITHDRAWALS_LIMIT (sic) preset of 2**20 and BUILDER_WITHDRAWAL_PREFIX 0x03 are added; ExecutionPayloadEnvelope gains execution_requests and slot; BeaconState gains execution_payload_availability, builder_pending_payments and builder_pending_withdrawals and loses latest_full_slot; process_execution_payload_header now queues a pending payment; a new epoch-processing helper process_builder_pending_payments is added; the unused AttestationData 'index' field is repurposed to signal payload availability. Fork choice is restructured: INTERVALS_PER_SLOT, PROPOSER_SCORE_BOOST, PAYLOAD_WITHHOLD_BOOST and PAYLOAD_REVEAL_BOOST are removed in favour of PAYLOAD_STATUS_PENDING/EMPTY/FULL, ChildNode becomes ForkChoiceNode, LatestMessage gains payload_present, the Store loses the withhold/reveal boost fields, and the 'Builder timeliness boosts' rationale and the 'Reorg resistance' security section are deleted. The inclusion-list compatibility reference changes from EIP-7547 to EIP-7805.; Classification rationale: Changes constants, container definitions, state fields, state-transition and fork-choice rules, the payment mechanism and the stated security properties. Substantive by every clause of the rubric, and the commit that also replaces one explicit cross-EIP reference with another.; Confidence: high; Commit: 105ac0656c0931dc6052581c41fa6225ea90afef; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/105ac0656c0931dc6052581c41fa6225ea90afef; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/105ac0656c0931dc6052581c41fa6225ea90afef

date: Feb 03, 2026; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-02-03T21:36:55+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Second full resynchronisation, this time against the Gloas specs: the six links move to consensus-specs c94138e73e0e70eb4b27f9be4d4e9325fa1aebf7 and from specs/_features/eip7732/ to specs/gloas/. Builders become a distinct in-protocol entity rather than an attribution of validators - a new BuilderIndex type, BUILDER_INDEX_FLAG, BUILDER_INDEX_SELF_BUILD, a Builder container and a builders registry with BUILDER_REGISTRY_LIMIT, MAX_BUILDERS_PER_WITHDRAWALS_SWEEP, MIN_BUILDER_WITHDRAWABILITY_DELAY and the BUILDER_PAYMENT_THRESHOLD numerator/denominator - and the Abstract records that builder stake is not actively validating, is exempt from the churn queues, can be as little as 1 ETH, and that trusted 'promise' payments are accommodated. SignedExecutionPayloadHeader is renamed SignedExecutionPayloadBid with a new ExecutionPayloadBid container; DOMAIN_BEACON_BUILDER changes from 0x1B000000 to 0x0B000000 and DOMAIN_PROPOSER_PREFERENCES 0x0D000000 is added; full BeaconBlockBody and BeaconState listings replace the prose deltas, with latest_withdrawals_root replaced by payload_expected_withdrawals and next_withdrawal_builder_index added; ExecutionPayloadEnvelope drops blob_kzg_commitments and payload_withheld; builder deposits with the builder withdrawal prefix are processed immediately; the fork-choice section is reduced to a one-line statement that forkchoice is changed substantially; a ProposerPreferences p2p topic is added; and a 'Free option problem' security section is added. Justin Traglia is added as an author.; Classification rationale: Changes types, containers, domain constants, the builder model, the withdrawal flow, the p2p topic set and the security analysis. Substantive, and the version of the specification that stands at the pinned repository commit.; Confidence: high; Commit: 4d7af9552edad39b66d82e4ea8403dce563a20be; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/4d7af9552edad39b66d82e4ea8403dce563a20be; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/4d7af9552edad39b66d82e4ea8403dce563a20be

date: Jul 13, 2026; event_kind: unknown; Normalized state: Uncertain transition; Recorded at: 2026-07-13T07:12:57Z; Historical label: listed under 'EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion' after removal of the 'Considered for Inclusion' heading; Normalization rationale: Commit e338bc94 (PR #11853) removed the 'Considered for Inclusion' heading, leaving the whole CFI list rendered under the 'EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion' heading. The PR body describes its intent as a stage restructuring that adds EIP-8282 and EIP-7610 to Considered for Inclusion, and the same-day correction PR #11917 states the changes 'were not completely correct'. Three days later the ACDE #241 call (2026-07-16) recorded that Glamsterdam EIPs were 'not yet moved to SFI' (ACDbot summary, 00:25:12), confirming no scheduling decision existed on 2026-07-13, so the apparent SFI placement is treated as an editorial error and normalized to unknown rather than scheduled_for_inclusion.; Source: ethereum/EIPs commit e338bc94c99e (Update EIP-7773: Update upgrade stages); Source URL: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/e338bc94c99e69ef86eed3cf6c5f7825073a61b1; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/e338bc94c99e69ef86eed3cf6c5f7825073a61b1

date: Aug 05, 2026; event_kind: scheduled_for_inclusion; Normalized state: SFI; Recorded at: 2026-08-05T02:55:08Z; Historical label: moved from 'Considered for Inclusion' to 'EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion' (SFI); Normalization rationale: The Meta EIP change moves the EIP from 'Considered for Inclusion' to 'EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion' and removes the CFI section. date: Jul 08, 2026; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-07-08T12:46:18Z; Change type: parameter; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Fixes the predeploy addresses to values derived from the current reference bytecode (PR #11899): BUILDER_DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS becomes 0x0000bFF46984e3725691FA540a8C7589300D8282 and BUILDER_EXIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS becomes 0x000064D678505ad48F8cCb093BC65613800E8282, both without placeholder markers; the Deployment paragraph is restated to say the addresses derive from the presigned deployment transactions for the current reference bytecode and will change if that bytecode changes.; Classification rationale: Replaces placeholder constants with concrete addresses that implementations and tests must use.; Confidence: high; Commit: 554d3325e31c3f74078402d961355218ece16bee; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/554d3325e31c3f74078402d961355218ece16bee; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/554d3325e31c3f74078402d961355218ece16bee

Medium confidence because the status move and comment removal alone would be non_substantive and the dropped text was a coordination note rather than a rule.; Confidence: medium; Commit: ba60c6474f603d93abbb4b0520f203dc8cb8c930; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/ba60c6474f603d93abbb4b0520f203dc8cb8c930; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/ba60c6474f603d93abbb4b0520f203dc8cb8c930

date: Aug 10, 2026; value: 4; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2026-08-10T15:23:39Z; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Cleanup and tweaks rewrite (PR #11869, 93 insertions / 72 deletions): adds Felix Lange as an author; replaces Nick's-method presigned deployment with deployment through the EIP-7997 CREATE2 factory using a mined salt; removes the EXCESS_INHIBITOR constant and its deployment-time inhibitor semantics; restructures the request-queue section into Write path / Fee getter / System call and adds that a SYSTEM_ADDRESS call carrying calldata permanently disables the queue via an inhibitor and that non-matching calls MUST revert; states that both contracts apply fee increases per write rather than at end of block, unlike EIP-7002; moves the request-type uniqueness statement below the constants table with a consensus-specs permalink; simplifies the deposit acceptance condition to msg.value >= amount * 1 gwei + fee; fills in Reference Implementation with ethereum/sys-asm links; and condenses Motivation, Rationale, Backwards Compatibility and Security Considerations into headed subsections.; Classification rationale: Changes the deployment mechanism, removes a constant, adds new system-call and revert rules and changes when the fee is updated; all are implementation- and test-visible.; Confidence: high; Commit: 2d3c5e59e47103df15e51aafc815ba0b234e3388; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/2d3c5e59e47103df15e51aafc815ba0b234e3388; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/2d3c5e59e47103df15e51aafc815ba0b234e3388
